question: Do they report results only on English data?
title: Towards a Continuous Knowledge Learning Engine for Chatbots
answer_rationale: The documents mention experiments on two standard real-world knowledge bases: Freebase and WordNet, which are not limited to English data. The text explicitly states, 'We empirically verify the effectiveness of LiLi on two standard real-world KBs: Freebase and WordNet,' indicating that results are reported on datasets that include non-English data as well.
